static_shell_probes.interpretation: The helper itself succeeds only for grep rc=1; matching and grep-error cases return nonzero and are fatal at simple-command call sites under the runner's global set -e.

p1_findings.finding: The exact four-member attempt population is checked immediately after creation, but final verification checks known seals and identity without rejecting a concurrently added fifth entry.
p1_findings.impact: No trusted claim field depends on an extra entry, so this is non-blocking under the single-owner non-adversarial execution contract.
p1_findings.recommended_fix: Reuse the exact-set and regular/non-symlink check immediately before canonical publish.

p1_findings.finding: The three-sample resource gate does not prevent a new EDA/DSE job from starting after the last sample.
p1_findings.impact: The current operator scheduling discipline makes this non-blocking, but the gate is not a mutual-exclusion proof.
p1_findings.recommended_fix: Use a shared atomic EDA lock and/or repeat the process exclusion check immediately before compile.

decision.reason: The assertion-evidence fail-open P0 and all four r1 P1 items are closed without introducing a new shell or one-shot P0.
decision.next_action: After M496 DC finishes, invoke the reviewed runner once with the literal expected SHA and let its three-sample resource gate decide admission.
